about: Built-in player characters. Each browser adds these to the World Bible as Party Members on first load. Bump a character's version to push changes (level-ups, new HP, a new picture) to browsers that already have them. Pictures: either "portraitId" (from the portrait library) or "image": { src, x, y, size } (a square crop of a file in assets/portraits/). A picture a player uploaded themselves is never replaced.

characters.title: John Farrier
characters.overview:
Human Warlock 3 · Farrier background

Stats

AC 12 · HP 33 · Speed 30 ft · Initiative +4 (Alert) · Proficiency +2 · Passive Perception 14 · Hit dice 3d8

STR 9 (−1) · DEX 14 (+2) · CON 16 (+3) · INT 10 (+0) · WIS 16 (+3) · CHA 20 (+5)

Saving throws: Wisdom, Charisma · Skills: History, Deception

Attacks

  • Eldritch Blast: +5 to hit, 1d10 force + Charisma (Agonizing Blast), pushes 10 ft (Repelling Blast)
  • Handaxe: +3 to hit, 1d6 + 3 slashing

Warlock

  • Pact Magic: 2 slots (2nd level), 2 cantrips, 4 prepared spells
  • Invocations (3): Agonizing Blast, Mask of Many Faces (Disguise Self at will, no slot), Repelling Blast
  • Patron: Awakened Mind, Psychic Spells

Feats

  • Tough
  • Alert

Proficiencies

Light armor · Simple weapons
